title: The Gravity of Station Meridian Anew
author: Ansel Yarrow
blurb: Jonah Okonkwo, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
